author: Riccardo Mariani
description: A car pulls up to the curb. The app says, “Your ride is here.” No one’s in the driver’s seat. The robotaxi industry has moved from prototype milestones to commercial operations, with an expanding ecosystem […]
title: For Robotaxis, Safety Must Be Built In, Not Bolted On

author: Michael Fukuyama
description: Today, Google DeepMind released DiffusionGemma — an experimental open model built for exceptionally fast text generation. NVIDIA has optimized DiffusionGemma to run even faster across NVIDIA GeForce RTX GPUs, the NVIDIA RTX PRO platform and NVIDIA DGX Spark systems, from local PCs to the cloud.  Rather than generating text one word at a time, DiffusionGemma generates multiple words in parallel to output whole blocks of text, opening a new, low-latency frontier for the kind of single-user workloads that developers, […]
title: NVIDIA Accelerates Google DeepMind’s DiffusionGemma for Local AI
